sourceTitle: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
originalTitle: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: Today, we’re sharing advances in how OpenAI models help engineers design, simulate, and build physical products. These capabilities span mechanical and electrical engineering and end-to-end system design, and are already helping our internal teams test ideas and iterate faster.
blocks.en: Today, we’re sharing advances in how OpenAI models help engineers design, simulate, and build physical products. These capabilities span mechanical and electrical engineering and end-to-end system design, and are already helping our internal teams test ideas and iterate faster.
blocks.zh: 今天，我们将分享 OpenAI 模型在帮助工程师设计、仿真和制造实体产品方面取得的进展。这些能力覆盖机械工程、电气工程及端到端系统设计，已经在帮助我们的内部团队更快地验证构想、迭代方案。

blocks.text: Across these projects, engineers need to bring together mechanical designs, electronics, software, and manufacturing requirements using specialized tools. We’re teaching models to support that work, from preparing drawings and setting up simulations to coordinating changes across disciplines. Our goal is to give engineers more time to explore ideas and improve designs.
blocks.en: Across these projects, engineers need to bring together mechanical designs, electronics, software, and manufacturing requirements using specialized tools. We’re teaching models to support that work, from preparing drawings and setting up simulations to coordinating changes across disciplines. Our goal is to give engineers more time to explore ideas and improve designs.
blocks.zh: 在这些项目中，工程师需要借助专业工具，将机械设计、电子系统、软件和制造要求统筹起来。我们正在训练模型来支持这类工作，从绘制图纸、设置仿真，到协调不同专业间的变更。我们的目标是让工程师有更多时间探索构想、改进设计。

blocks.text: Over the past year, improved frontier model capabilities have helped our internal teams test new ideas and iterate faster, and we are seeing early evidence of these capabilities improving professional workflows in industry as well. We’re working with collaborators to understand where these capabilities can make the biggest difference and what needs to improve. If you’re an engineer, engineering firm, or software vendor involved in the design, simulation, manufacturing, or production of complex physical products, we’d love to work with you to shape this effort around the tools you use and the problems you need to solve.
blocks.en: Over the past year, improved frontier model capabilities have helped our internal teams test new ideas and iterate faster, and we are seeing early evidence of these capabilities improving professional workflows in industry as well. We’re working with collaborators to understand where these capabilities can make the biggest difference and what needs to improve. If you’re an engineer, engineering firm, or software vendor involved in the design, simulation, manufacturing, or production of complex physical products, we’d love to work with you to shape this effort around the tools you use and the problems you need to solve.
blocks.zh: 过去一年里，前沿模型能力的提升帮助我们的内部团队更快地验证新构想、迭代方案。我们也看到了初步证据，表明这些能力正在改善行业中的专业工作流程。我们正与合作者一道，了解这些能力在哪些环节最能发挥作用，以及还有哪些方面需要改进。如果你是从事复杂实体产品设计、仿真、制造或生产的工程师、工程公司或软件供应商，我们期待与你合作，围绕你使用的工具和需要解决的问题，共同推进这项工作。

blocks.text: Designing a device with Astra
blocks.en: Designing a device with Astra
blocks.zh: 使用 Astra 设计设备

blocks.text: We tested Astra’s state-of-the-art performance in multimodal and computer use workflows by seeing if we can create a device without any direct human edits. To do this, we used GPT‑6 to define the functional requirements and design the enclosure, printed circuit board (PCB), and software integrations needed to create a device users can use to talk to Codex.
blocks.en: We tested Astra’s state-of-the-art performance in multimodal and computer use workflows by seeing if we can create a device without any direct human edits. To do this, we used GPT‑6 to define the functional requirements and design the enclosure, printed circuit board (PCB), and software integrations needed to create a device users can use to talk to Codex.
blocks.zh: 我们尝试在完全不由人类直接修改的情况下创造一款设备，以此检验 Astra 在多模态和计算机使用工作流程中的领先表现。为此，我们使用 GPT‑6 定义功能需求，并设计外壳、印刷电路板（PCB）以及所需的软件集成，打造一款让用户能与 Codex 对话的设备。

blocks.text: Aesthetics and design: Astra developed the look of the device, drawing on our recent Work Louder collaboration and references from games and toys.
blocks.en: Aesthetics and design: Astra developed the look of the device, drawing on our recent Work Louder collaboration and references from games and toys.
blocks.zh: 美学与设计：Astra 借鉴了我们近期与 Work Louder 的合作成果，并从游戏和玩具中汲取灵感，设计了设备的外观。

blocks.text: Mechanical design: Astra designed the enclosure and the internal structures that hold the components in place.
blocks.en: Mechanical design: Astra designed the enclosure and the internal structures that hold the components in place.
blocks.zh: 机械设计：Astra 设计了外壳以及用于固定各部件的内部结构。

blocks.text: Electrical design: Astra selected the electrical components and designed the printed circuit board (PCB), including component placement and connections, to fit within the enclosure.
blocks.en: Electrical design: Astra selected the electrical components and designed the printed circuit board (PCB), including component placement and connections, to fit within the enclosure.
blocks.zh: 电气设计：Astra 选择了电子元器件，并设计了能装入外壳的印刷电路板（PCB），包括元器件布局和连接。

blocks.text: UI/UX and software: Astra designed the user interface and generated the firmware and software integrations needed to connect the device to Codex.
blocks.en: UI/UX and software: Astra designed the user interface and generated the firmware and software integrations needed to connect the device to Codex.
blocks.zh: 用户界面、用户体验与软件：Astra 设计了用户界面，并生成了将设备连接到 Codex 所需的固件和软件集成。

blocks.text: Two team members designed this test device with Astra in under a week while working on it as a side project. A contract manufacturer built a small batch of prototypes in under a month.
blocks.en: Two team members designed this test device with Astra in under a week while working on it as a side project. A contract manufacturer built a small batch of prototypes in under a month.
blocks.zh: 两名团队成员将这款测试设备作为业余项目，借助 Astra 在不到一周内完成了设计。一家代工厂在不到一个月内制成了小批量原型机。

blocks.text: Getting the device ready for manufacturing still required several rounds of review and iteration. Astra did not consistently account for the manufacturer’s production limits, tolerances, or details required for assembly. These gaps are helping us identify what future models need to do better.
blocks.en: Getting the device ready for manufacturing still required several rounds of review and iteration. Astra did not consistently account for the manufacturer’s production limits, tolerances, or details required for assembly. These gaps are helping us identify what future models need to do better.
blocks.zh: 要让设备达到可投产的要求，仍然需要多轮评审和迭代。Astra 并非总能考虑到制造商的生产限制、公差或装配所需的细节。这些不足正帮助我们明确未来模型需要改进的方向。

blocks.text: Accelerating OpenAI hardware teams
blocks.en: Accelerating OpenAI hardware teams
blocks.zh: 助力 OpenAI 硬件团队提速

blocks.text: OpenAI’s hardware and infrastructure teams use Codex and ChatGPT to create and revise computer-aided design (CAD) models, prepare manufacturing drawings, set up simulations, and review designs. This work spans robotics and compute infrastructure. Since February, model usage across our hardware teams, measured in tokens, has grown 23-fold.
blocks.en: OpenAI’s hardware and infrastructure teams use Codex and ChatGPT to create and revise computer-aided design (CAD) models, prepare manufacturing drawings, set up simulations, and review designs. This work spans robotics and compute infrastructure. Since February, model usage across our hardware teams, measured in tokens, has grown 23-fold.
blocks.zh: OpenAI 的硬件和基础设施团队使用 Codex 和 ChatGPT 创建、修改计算机辅助设计 (CAD) 模型，绘制制造图纸，设置仿真并评审设计。这些工作涵盖机器人和计算基础设施。自 2 月以来，以 Token 数量衡量的各硬件团队模型用量已增至原来的 23 倍。

blocks.text: “Codex has dramatically accelerated how we move from an idea to an engineered part. We’re iterating faster across CAD, converting 3D designs into production-ready 2D drawings, and setting up simulations and FEA with far less manual work.”
blocks.en: “Codex has dramatically accelerated how we move from an idea to an engineered part. We’re iterating faster across CAD, converting 3D designs into production-ready 2D drawings, and setting up simulations and FEA with far less manual work.”
blocks.zh: “Codex 大幅加快了我们从构想到完成零件工程设计的进程。我们在 CAD 中的各项迭代更快了，能将三维设计转化为可直接用于生产的二维图纸，并以少得多的手动操作完成仿真和有限元分析（FEA）的设置。”

blocks.text: — Grace Lam, Forward Deployed Engineer at OpenAI
blocks.en: — Grace Lam, Forward Deployed Engineer at OpenAI
blocks.zh: — Grace Lam，OpenAI 前线部署工程师

blocks.text: “As system hardware designers, we use Codex and ChatGPT to organize cross-functional design constraints, explore system architectures, execute across ECAD environments, and conduct thorough design reviews. Today, Codex and ChatGPT are dependable, around-the-clock partners in engineering and project management, with the potential to grow into teams of hardware specialists that can take a board from concept to Gerber out.”
blocks.en: “As system hardware designers, we use Codex and ChatGPT to organize cross-functional design constraints, explore system architectures, execute across ECAD environments, and conduct thorough design reviews. Today, Codex and ChatGPT are dependable, around-the-clock partners in engineering and project management, with the potential to grow into teams of hardware specialists that can take a board from concept to Gerber out.”
blocks.zh: “作为系统硬件设计师，我们使用 Codex 和 ChatGPT 梳理跨职能的设计约束、探索系统架构、在不同的电子计算机辅助设计（ECAD）环境中执行任务，并开展全面的设计评审。如今，Codex 和 ChatGPT 已是工程与项目管理中全天候可靠的伙伴，未来还有潜力发展为硬件专家团队，完成从电路板构想到 Gerber 文件输出的全流程工作。”

blocks.text: — Qiong Wang, Member of Technical Staff at OpenAI
blocks.en: — Qiong Wang, Member of Technical Staff at OpenAI
blocks.zh: — Qiong Wang，OpenAI 技术团队成员

blocks.text: “In AEC and BIM, a lot of time goes into repetitive modeling, checking information across drawings and specifications, and coordinating changes between disciplines. We're starting to use Codex to automate routine tasks, flag inconsistencies, and turn coordination findings into clear, actionable issues. This frees up time for teams to evaluate design options and constructability, with architects, engineers, and BIM professionals reviewing and validating the results.”
blocks.en: “In AEC and BIM, a lot of time goes into repetitive modeling, checking information across drawings and specifications, and coordinating changes between disciplines. We're starting to use Codex to automate routine tasks, flag inconsistencies, and turn coordination findings into clear, actionable issues. This frees up time for teams to evaluate design options and constructability, with architects, engineers, and BIM professionals reviewing and validating the results.”
blocks.zh: “在建筑、工程与施工（AEC）及建筑信息模型（BIM）领域，重复建模、核对图纸与规格文件中的信息，以及协调不同专业间的变更，都需要耗费大量时间。我们正开始使用 Codex 自动处理常规任务、标记不一致之处，并将协调过程中发现的问题整理成清晰、可执行的事项。这让团队能腾出时间评估设计方案和施工可行性，同时由建筑师、工程师和 BIM 专业人员审核并验证结果。”

blocks.text: Measuring progress on engineering tasks
blocks.en: Measuring progress on engineering tasks
blocks.zh: 衡量工程任务上的进展

blocks.text: We’re also measuring progress in newer models on tasks that combine coding with engineering knowledge. BenchCAD 2.0 tests whether models can reconstruct 3D parts and assemblies and identify connections in circuit boards. A newer internal model achieved an average score of 0.875, compared with 0.594 for GPT‑6 Astra at its highest reasoning setting. While the engineering lifecycle includes many other elements beyond design, we view improvements in capability here as early evidence of the ability of AI models to positively impact iteration speed for professional workflows.
blocks.en: We’re also measuring progress in newer models on tasks that combine coding with engineering knowledge. BenchCAD 2.0 tests whether models can reconstruct 3D parts and assemblies and identify connections in circuit boards. A newer internal model achieved an average score of 0.875, compared with 0.594 for GPT‑6 Astra at its highest reasoning setting. While the engineering lifecycle includes many other elements beyond design, we view improvements in capability here as early evidence of the ability of AI models to positively impact iteration speed for professional workflows.
blocks.zh: 我们也在衡量较新模型在结合编程与工程知识的任务上取得的进展。BenchCAD 2.0 测试模型能否重建三维零件和装配体，以及识别电路板中的连接。一个较新的内部模型取得了 0.875 的平均分，而 GPT‑6 Astra 在最高推理设置下的平均分为 0.594。尽管工程全生命周期除了设计还包括许多其他环节，但我们认为，这方面的能力提升提供了初步证据，表明 AI 模型能够加快专业工作流程中的迭代速度。

blocks.text: Safely deploying with industry collaborators
blocks.en: Safely deploying with industry collaborators
blocks.zh: 与行业合作者共同实现安全部署

blocks.text: We’re working with a small group of industry collaborators to test these capabilities on real engineering problems. Their engineers review model outputs for accuracy and practical use, helping us understand which tasks models can support today and what needs to be improved for safe and reliable use.
blocks.en: We’re working with a small group of industry collaborators to test these capabilities on real engineering problems. Their engineers review model outputs for accuracy and practical use, helping us understand which tasks models can support today and what needs to be improved for safe and reliable use.
blocks.zh: 我们正与少数行业合作者一道，在实际工程问题中测试这些能力。他们的工程师会审核模型输出的准确性和实用性，帮助我们了解模型目前能支持哪些任务，以及要实现安全可靠的使用还需要改进哪些方面。

blocks.text: We’re expanding our collaboration with Chip Ganassi Racing (CGR) to explore how OpenAI models can accelerate engineering and prototyping. Working with its R&D team, we’re testing workflows that turn 3D scans of existing parts into editable CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings. This is particularly useful when the original design files are unavailable.
blocks.en: We’re expanding our collaboration with Chip Ganassi Racing (CGR) to explore how OpenAI models can accelerate engineering and prototyping. Working with its R&D team, we’re testing workflows that turn 3D scans of existing parts into editable CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings. This is particularly useful when the original design files are unavailable.
blocks.zh: 我们正在扩大与 Chip Ganassi Racing (CAD) 的合作，探索 OpenAI 模型如何加快工程开发和原型制作。我们正与其研发团队合作，测试将现有零件的三维扫描数据转化为可编辑 CAD 模型和二维制造图纸的工作流程。在无法获取原始设计文件时，这种方式尤其有用。

blocks.text: CGR engineers review the models and drawings for accuracy and manufacturability. Their feedback helps us identify where models can reduce manual work and where further improvements are needed.
blocks.en: CGR engineers review the models and drawings for accuracy and manufacturability. Their feedback helps us identify where models can reduce manual work and where further improvements are needed.
blocks.zh: CGR 工程师会审核模型和图纸的准确性与可制造性。他们的反馈帮助我们确定，模型在哪些环节可以减少手动工作，以及哪些方面仍需改进。

blocks.text: “The model has been useful for going from raw scan data to a solid body. I have been working with Codex directly in CAD. The feedback I give the model is directly applied, the manual tweaks can be made directly, and this has become a faster, more hands-off process for me.”
blocks.en: “The model has been useful for going from raw scan data to a solid body. I have been working with Codex directly in CAD. The feedback I give the model is directly applied, the manual tweaks can be made directly, and this has become a faster, more hands-off process for me.”
blocks.zh: “在将原始扫描数据转化为实体模型的过程中，这个模型很有帮助。我一直直接在 CAD 中使用 Codex。我给模型的反馈能直接落实，需要手动微调的地方也能直接修改。对我来说，整个流程更快了，需要我亲自动手的地方也更少了。”

blocks.text: — Matthew Ortman, R&D Engineer at Chip Ganassi Racing
blocks.en: — Matthew Ortman, R&D Engineer at Chip Ganassi Racing
blocks.zh: — Matthew Ortman，Chip Ganassi Racing 研发工程师

blocks.text: We’re also announcing a new research collaboration with Mazda. Our research and Forward Deployed Engineering teams are working with Mazda’s aerodynamics and crash-safety engineers to explore how OpenAI models can help develop and evaluate new vehicle designs.
blocks.en: We’re also announcing a new research collaboration with Mazda. Our research and Forward Deployed Engineering teams are working with Mazda’s aerodynamics and crash-safety engineers to explore how OpenAI models can help develop and evaluate new vehicle designs.
blocks.zh: 我们同时宣布与马自达开展一项新的研究合作。我们的研究团队和前线部署工程团队正与马自达的空气动力学及碰撞安全工程师合作，探索 OpenAI 模型如何帮助开发和评估新的汽车设计。

blocks.text: The work uses simulations of airflow and structural behavior to explore improvements in performance while accounting for styling and cost. We’ll share more progress and results in the coming months.
blocks.en: The work uses simulations of airflow and structural behavior to explore improvements in performance while accounting for styling and cost. We’ll share more progress and results in the coming months.
blocks.zh: 这项工作通过气流与结构响应仿真，探索在兼顾造型和成本的同时提升性能的方法。我们将在未来几个月分享更多进展和成果。

blocks.text: GPT‑6 Astra helps Mazda’s aerodynamics engineers explore ways to reduce vehicle drag by modeling new nose shapes, simulating airflow, and refining the most promising designs. Agreement for use has been obtained from Mazda Motor Corporation. Any republication or reuse elsewhere is strictly prohibited.
blocks.en: GPT‑6 Astra helps Mazda’s aerodynamics engineers explore ways to reduce vehicle drag by modeling new nose shapes, simulating airflow, and refining the most promising designs. Agreement for use has been obtained from Mazda Motor Corporation. Any republication or reuse elsewhere is strictly prohibited.
blocks.zh: GPT‑6 Astra 通过对新车头造型建模、模拟气流并优化最有前景的设计，帮助马自达的空气动力学工程师探索降低车辆风阻的方法。已获得马自达汽车株式会社的使用授权。严禁在其他地方转载或再次使用。

blocks.text: “Does it have to look like that?” Our designers often ask us when we find a shape that improves airflow. By exploring and simulating dozens of variations, Astra in Codex helps us understand which features matter for aerodynamics and where designers have room to explore. That’s why the value of Astra and collaborating with OpenAI goes beyond task automation and shortening development cycles: it is helping us bring together Mazda’s distinctive design and aerodynamic performance without treating either as a compromise.”
blocks.en: “Does it have to look like that?” Our designers often ask us when we find a shape that improves airflow. By exploring and simulating dozens of variations, Astra in Codex helps us understand which features matter for aerodynamics and where designers have room to explore. That’s why the value of Astra and collaborating with OpenAI goes beyond task automation and shortening development cycles: it is helping us bring together Mazda’s distinctive design and aerodynamic performance without treating either as a compromise.”
blocks.zh: “‘一定要做成这个样子吗？’每当我们找到一种能改善气流的造型时，设计师常常会这样问。通过探索数十种变体并进行仿真，Codex 中的 Astra 帮助我们了解哪些特征对空气动力学性能至关重要，以及哪些地方能给设计师留下探索空间。因此，Astra 以及与 OpenAI 合作的价值，不仅在于自动执行任务、缩短开发周期，更在于帮助我们兼顾马自达独特的设计风格与空气动力学性能，让两者都不必妥协。”

blocks.text: — Akihiro Nakata, Principal Engineer at Mazda
blocks.en: — Akihiro Nakata, Principal Engineer at Mazda
blocks.zh: — Akihiro Nakata，马自达首席工程师

blocks.text: Help shape AI for engineering and manufacturing
blocks.en: Help shape AI for engineering and manufacturing
blocks.zh: 携手塑造面向工程与制造的 AI

blocks.text: We have been working closely with industry partners and early adopters to push the bounds of what we can do with AI agents in hardware and manufacturing. These early results have shown exciting promise, and we’re now looking for collaborators to accelerate these capability improvements and ensure we deploy these safely into industry.
blocks.en: We have been working closely with industry partners and early adopters to push the bounds of what we can do with AI agents in hardware and manufacturing. These early results have shown exciting promise, and we’re now looking for collaborators to accelerate these capability improvements and ensure we deploy these safely into industry.
blocks.zh: 我们一直与行业合作伙伴和早期采用者密切合作，拓展 AI 智能体在硬件和制造领域的应用边界。这些早期成果展现出令人振奋的潜力。我们正在寻找合作者，共同加快能力提升，并确保将这些能力安全地部署到行业中。

blocks.text: If you are interested in working with us to shape the training and development of our frontier models by identifying high-value use cases, software tooling, or future opportunities in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electromechanical design, mechatronics, or a related field, please fill out this form and we'll be in touch.
blocks.en: If you are interested in working with us to shape the training and development of our frontier models by identifying high-value use cases, software tooling, or future opportunities in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electromechanical design, mechatronics, or a related field, please fill out this form and we'll be in touch.
blocks.zh: 如果你有兴趣与我们合作，发掘机械工程、电气工程、机电设计、机电一体化或相关领域的高价值用例、软件工具或未来机遇，为我们的前沿模型训练与开发提供方向，请填写此表单，我们会与你联系。

Today, Codex and ChatGPT are dependable, around-the-clock partners in engineering and project management, with the potential to grow into teams of hardware specialists that can take a board from concept to Gerber out.”

keyPoints.zh: 如果你有兴趣与我们合作，发掘机械工程、电气工程、机电设计、机电一体化或相关领域的高价值用例、软件工具或未来机遇，为我们的前沿模型训练与开发提供方向，请填写此表单，我们会与你联系。
keyPoints.en: If you are interested in working with us to shape the training and development of our frontier models by identifying high-value use cases, software tooling, or future opportunities in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electromechanical design, mechatronics, or a related field, please fill out this form and we'll be in touch.
